exposure: Mean number of hysterectomies performed annually
outcome: Prevalence of placenta previa in the setting of previous cesarean delivery
cohort: Women who underwent delivery (n=5,388,486) at hospitals in the Perspective database between 2006 and 2014
finding: Peripartum hysterectomy rates increased overall, with the largest increases seen in hospitals with high delivery volumes and high rates of hysterectomies.
